public.title: Classnames
public.description: Join CSS class tokens with single spaces. Input is an array of nested arrays, strings, integers, booleans, null, and objects. Ignore falsy scalars; convert nonzero integers to decimal text; keep strings as single tokens without trimming. For an object include its keys whose values are truthy under JavaScript JSON truthiness, in Object.keys order. Recursively flatten arrays. Object values are not recursively traversed. Supported inputs are dense JSON values only: at most 100 total nodes, nesting depth at most 6, each string at most 80 UTF-16 code units, and integers from -1000 through 1000 unless narrower bounds are given. Unless the adapter explicitly defines path keys or another key format, object keys are nonempty ASCII letters without dots. All keys exclude prototype-related names. Inputs are valid; no validation is requested. Array order matters, object key order does not. Return a JSON value; no browser or third-party library is available. The complete serialized argument array is limited to 2048 UTF-8 bytes, counting JSON escaping. These whole-input limits also apply to descriptors, operations and nested values.
